definitions.gloss: attendance record; roll book; attendance register
definitions.explanation: A book or record used to track attendance, especially in schools and classrooms. The teacher typically calls roll and marks attendance in this record.

examples.japanese: ⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{出席簿|しゅっせきぼ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}った→取る：00565_toru⟧。
{出席簿|しゅっせきぼ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦なかった→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: My name wasn't in the attendance record.

examples.japanese: ⟦{担任|たんにん}→担任：16408_tannin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{毎朝|まいあさ}→毎朝：00966_maiasa⟧{出席簿|しゅっせきぼ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧⟦ずつ→〜ずつ：03092_zutsu⟧⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{呼|よ}んで→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧いく。
examples.english: The homeroom teacher calls out each student's name while looking at the attendance book every morning.

notes:
USAGE: {出席簿|しゅっせきぼ} is primarily associated with schools and classrooms. The teacher uses it to record which students are present, absent, or late.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {出席簿|しゅっせきぼ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧: to take attendance
- {出席簿|しゅっせきぼ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{記録|きろく}する→記録する：25341_kirokusuru⟧: to record in the attendance book
- {出席簿|しゅっせきぼ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧: to check the attendance record

The word is a compound of ⟦{出席|しゅっせき}→出席：02084_shusseki⟧ (attendance) and {簿|ぼ} (register, ledger).
